info.name: HackMate API
info.description: Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Tokens and ids are stored in collection variables automatically.

item.name: Assign Judge - user is not a judge (400)
Create Team - already in a team (409)
Add Member - user is a judge (400)
Update Project - not a team member (403)
Create Review - score out of range (400)

exec: pm.test("ranked by average score", () => { pm.expect(lb[0].rank).to.eql(1); pm.expect(lb[0].team).to.eql("Code Warriors"); pm.expect(lb[0].averageScore).to.eql(9); pm.expect(lb[1].averageScore).to.eql(7); });
